content.value: Primary reading: Rozanski and Woods, Chapters 18-19. This unit focuses on information viewpoint.

The information viewpoint focuses on data, information models, ownership, lifecycle, integrity, privacy, and flows. Many architectural failures come from unclear data meaning or inconsistent ownership rather than from code structure alone.
Information modeling at architecture level is not about every database column. It is about the data concepts and flows that shape integration, correctness, compliance, and analytics.
Studio: identify the authoritative owner for customer profile data, billing data, and audit data in a multi-system product.

concepts.name: Information viewpoint
concepts.description: A viewpoint focused on data concepts, ownership, lifecycle, integrity, and movement across the system.

concepts.name: Data ownership
concepts.description: The architectural assignment of authority for creating, changing, validating, and interpreting data.

concepts.name: Canonical information model
concepts.description: A shared representation of important domain information used to align systems or integrations.

concepts.name: Data lifecycle
concepts.description: The stages through which data is created, used, retained, archived, deleted, or audited.
